lines.text: Leo crossed one muddy stream in his cotton gym socks.
Ten minutes later his feet were cold, wet and rubbing raw.
Cotton soaks up water and holds it against your skin.
A friend handed him a dry pair of merino wool socks.
Wool stays warmer when damp and pulls sweat away from your feet.
Pack a spare pair in a dry bag too.
Leo finished the loop with happy feet.
Save this before your next hike.
